title: Commercial Drones Now Outnumber Hobby Drones
hook: The drone hobby quietly became an industry.
closing: Commercial drones now dominate registrations, putting more working aircraft in shared airspace.
question: Have you flown a drone?

segments.say: Commercial drones reached 453,635 registrations, overtaking recreational models and turning a toy craze into an industry.
Registered drones climbed to 837,513, putting more aircraft than ever into shared airspace.
New drone registrations slowed to 10,500 monthly, showing the boom is cooling even as the fleet grows.
